public_documentation_findings.interpretation: A public per-pull specialization roster API is documented. Desktop App uploads and guild/pull selectors are required. It is not an aggregate popularity endpoint. Current raid/date identity, sample selection and role-slot denominators would need verification before extraction. Documentation and failed probes supply no representation rates.
public_documentation_findings.probe_selectors: The documented example raid slug the-unbinding-of-kithix and exploratory us/illidan/Liquid selector are connectivity probes only; neither is asserted to be the target patch/season sample.

structural_limitations: The enabled WarcraftLogs adapter checks expansion metadata only; it has no quantitative raid collector. A successful token or metadata request alone cannot count as coverage.

The strict gate currently accepts successful Archon or Raider.IO sources only. A future WCL implementation needs validated quantitative eligibility and provenance before the gate can recognize it; it must never accept metadata alone.
